# AMT Toolbox

> Free calculators, reference tables, and FAA A&P exam practice questions for aircraft maintenance technicians and A&P certification students.

AMT Toolbox is a free, open-access utility site built specifically for Aircraft Maintenance Technicians and A&P certification students. The tools a mechanic needs day to day (torque calculations, bend allowance formulas, hardware lookups) are normally scattered across textbooks, manufacturer documentation, and decade-old desktop apps. AMT Toolbox collects them in one place, built for the way technicians actually work: fast lookup, mobile-friendly, and available anywhere there is a signal.

Every tool is stateless and client-side. No data leaves your device, no account is required, and nothing is logged. All tools, reference tables, and study material are free.

## Calculators

- [Bend allowance calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/bend-allowance-calculator) — bend allowance, setback, and flat blank length for sheet metal work
- [Rivet size calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/rivet-size-calculator) — rivet diameter, edge distance, pitch, and grip length for sheet metal repairs
- [Torque extension calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/torque-extension-calculator) — the correct torque wrench setting when using an extension tool
- [Torque unit converter](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/torque-unit-converter) — in-lb, ft-lb, N·m, and kgf·cm, with an AN bolt reference table
- [Weight and balance calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/weight-balance-calculator) — weight, moment, and CG location
- [Wire gauge calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/wire-gauge-calculator)
- [Hydraulic calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/hydraulic-calculator)
- [Ohm's law calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/ohms-law-calculator)
- [Fuel burn calculator](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/fuel-burn-calculator)
- [Decimal to fraction converter](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/decimal-fraction-converter)
- [AN hardware decoder](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/an-hardware-decoder) — decode AN aircraft hardware part numbers
- [MS hardware decoder](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/ms-hardware-decoder) — decode MS aircraft hardware part numbers
- [Compression check reference](https://www.amttoolbox.com/tools/compression-check-reference)

## Notes for Agents

- Everything is free and open access. No account or signup is required for any tool or study section.
- **Accuracy disclaimer (quoted from the About page):** AMT Toolbox is provided for educational and reference purposes only. Always verify calculations against FAA-approved maintenance manuals, aircraft documentation, and applicable regulations. This site does not replace the judgment of a certificated aviation maintenance technician.
- Calculators return a result without server round-trips, so content is identical for crawlers and users, and the same tool output is reachable directly by URL.
